name: ResizeColumnsRowsInExcelWorksheet
label: Resize Columns or Rows in Excel Worksheet
description: Resizes the width of columns or the height of rows in the provided Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object in which columns or rows should be resized.

fields.name: ResizeTarget
fields.label: Resize Target
fields.description: Specifies whether to resize Columns or Rows.

fields.name: SelectionRange
fields.label: Selection Range
fields.description: Specifies how to select the range to resize: All available, Range, or Single.

selectOptions.label: All available
selectOptions.description: Resizes all columns or rows in the worksheet.

selectOptions.label: Range
selectOptions.description: Resizes a specified range of columns or rows.

selectOptions.label: Single
selectOptions.description: Resizes a single column or row.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to resize (required if 'Selection Range' is 'Range').

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to resize (required if 'Selection Range' is 'Range').

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') to resize (required if 'Selection Range' is 'Single').

fields.name: ResizeType
fields.label: Resize Type
fields.description: Choose whether to resize using a custom size or autofit.

selectOptions.label: Autofit
selectOptions.description: Automatically adjusts the size based on content.

selectOptions.label: Custom size
selectOptions.description: Sets a custom width or height.

fields.name: Width
fields.label: Width
fields.description: The new width for columns or height for rows (required if 'Resize Type' is 'Custom Size').
